explanation: Norin–Turcotte (JCTB 168, arXiv:2207.04035, 'The burning number conjecture holds asymptotically') prove b(G) ≤ (1 + o(1))√n for connected G on n vertices. The formal version: for every ε > 0 there is n0 such that every connected finite graph with ≥ n0 vertices has b(G) ≤ (1+ε)√n, which is the unpacking of the o(1). Faithful.
